page_title: GET 2-0 VLL | Getafe v Valladolid 22/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows for a foul after Christantus Uche (Getafe) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
90+5' Domingos Duarte (Getafe) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
90+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) was quite harsh and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+2' Getafe take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+2' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. The ball is out of play. Getafe will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+1' Christantus Uche (Getafe) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Kike Perez (Valladolid) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to David Soria, who smothers the ball.
90' Valladolid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90' Raul Moro (Valladolid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag and Valladolid will take a corner.
89' The referee signals a substitution. Domingos Duarte (Getafe) is brought on as a substitute for Allan Nyom.
89' Jose Bordalas Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Carles Perez will be replaced by Yellu Santiago (Getafe).
88' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) makes a strong challenge and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows for a foul.
86' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 12:14.
85' Substitution. Mamadou Sylla will be replaced by Marcos Andre (Valladolid).
85' Allan Nyom (Getafe) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
84' The linesman signals that Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
83' Referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes sees the trip by Christantus Uche (Getafe) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
82' Raul Moro (Valladolid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
81' The free kick is taken by Kike Perez (Valladolid), but ball is cleared.
81' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle and signals a foul after Carles Perez (Getafe) brought his opponent down. A free kick has been awarded to Valladolid.

81' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
80' Getafe failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
79' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Getafe, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Good work from Getafe as they win a corner.
79' Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) is penalised for holding. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes signals a set piece.
77' Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
76' Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
74' The manager makes a subsitution with Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) coming on for Javier Sanchez.
73' 2 - 0 Goal! Allan Nyom (Getafe) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 2:0.
73' Getafe force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
72' One of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital stop to deny a close-range header from Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe). Getafe earn a corner.
70' 1 - 0 Goal! Allan Nyom shows great vision to find Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the left side of the goal. 1:0.
66' Substitution. Mario Martin (Valladolid) replaces Stanko Juric.
66' Here is a change. Anuar is going off and Paulo Pezzolano gives the last tactical orders to Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid).
65' Substitution. Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Bertug Yildirim walks off.
64' Allan Nyom (Getafe) is penalised for a foul. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes had a clear view and blows his whistle.
61' Allan Nyom (Getafe) sees a yellow card from Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
61' Anuar (Valladolid) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
61' Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
59' Christantus Uche (Getafe) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Karl Hein has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
55' Today's match ends for Alex Sola who will be replaced by Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe).
48' Javier Sanchez (Valladolid) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
47' Alex Sola (Getafe) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Jose Bordalas Jimenez isn't happy on the touchline after referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes shows him a yellow card.
45+4' Holy smokes, you don't see that very often! Paulo Pezzolano gets a second yellow card and has to leave the bench.
45+4' Kike Perez (Valladolid) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
45+2' Paulo Pezzolano appears to have said too much and referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Getafe for a penalty. Play continues.
43' Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The ball is out of play. Valladolid will have a throw-in.
42' Stanko Juric (Valladolid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
41' A clumsy foul by Carles Perez (Getafe) and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle.
40' Raul Moro (Valladolid) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
39' Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
37' Kike Perez (Valladolid) strikes the ball goalwards from a mid-range free kick, but his effort goes towards the middle of the goal. Not a big deal for the goalkeeper.
35' Djene (Getafe) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes had an easy-decision to make.

32' Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.

31' Luis Milla (Getafe) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards right side of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Karl Hein pulls off an easy save.
30' Carles Perez (Getafe) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
28' Luis Milla (Getafe) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.

28' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle after Kike Perez (Valladolid) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. It's a free kick to Getafe, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
26' Luis Milla (Getafe) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
26' Karl Hein (Valladolid) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
24' Karl Hein (Valladolid) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
24' Diego Rico (Getafe) sends a cross into the box, but Karl Hein comes off his line to gather the ball.
22' Carles Perez (Getafe) serves up a nice cross, but Karl Hein punches the ball away.
19' Poor challenge! Kike Perez (Valladolid) is penalised for tripping and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle.
19' Kike Perez (Valladolid) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows for a foul.
16' Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
16' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Getafe, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

15' Stanko Juric (Valladolid) brings his opponent down. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Getafe earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
14' A lofted cross from Christantus Uche (Getafe) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The linesman signals a throw-in for Getafe.
11' Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.
10' Raul Moro (Valladolid) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
9' Luis Milla (Getafe) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
8' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle. Kike Perez (Valladolid) commits a foul after dangerous play.
8' Paulo Pezzolano (Valladolid) is awarded a second yellow by Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes and subsequently dismisses him with a red one.
6' The ball is cleared after Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
5' Having seen unsporting behavior, Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Jose Bordalas Jimenez (Getafe) is the recipient.
4' Flag goes up against Raul Moro (Valladolid) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

3' Allan Nyom (Getafe) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.
3' Carles Perez (Getafe) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
1' Valladolid take a short corner kick.
1' Valladolid spell of possession comes to an end after a mistake. Valladolid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Valladolid will take the kick-off.
Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
